subject: Net terms proposal, conditional credit cap, and EU VAT routing
messages:
From: Celia Park <celia.park@medicore.io>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: MedicoRe Billing <billing@medicore.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Request to move to Net45 + credit cap for pilot

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — quick ask as we prep purchase order 4571 for the Redwood Dedicated pilot. Our procurement team needs Net45 on the PO rather than Net30 to align with our month-end collections. We understand Redwood’s standard is Net30; that’s fine, but for the pilot we’re requesting a temporary Net45 for the first three invoices.

Two additional items:
- Can we agree a temporary credit cap (ceiling) of EUR 120k for the pilot period, with the ability to re-evaluate once we hit 75% utilization?
- We bill out of our UK entity; please confirm whether Redwood can route invoices to MedicoRe UK and include the attached tax certificate so we can handle VAT locally.

Attached: PO draft. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Celia Park
Head of Procurement, MedicoRe Health
[attachment: MedicoRe_PO_4571.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Celia Park <celia.park@medicore.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, MedicoRe Billing <billing@medicore.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request to move to Net45 + credit cap for pilot

Hi Celia — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the PO. I looped in Laura (Finance) and Marcus (Customer Ops) to confirm internal approvals. Quick responses to your points:

- Net45 for first three invoices: we can accept that as a temporary amendment for the pilot period, provided we have a signed amendment to the SOW that lists the three invoice dates (we’ll sync invoice numbers to PO 4571).
- Temporary credit cap: we can set a conditional credit ceiling. Proposed language: initial cap EUR 120,000; automatic review when projected monthly consumption reaches 75% of cap; Redwood reserves right to request cadence changes or shorter payment terms if usage steps above forecast by >30% in a 30-day window.
- VAT/invoicing to UK: we can route invoices to your UK entity. Please attach the UK tax certificate (to satisfy our AR checks) and confirm the exact VAT registration number we should include on invoices.

I’ve attached a draft one-page amendment and our invoice template. Laura — can you confirm the credit check cadence and whether Finance needs any additional collateral for the EUR 120k cap? Marcus — please flag any operational constraints on prorating a month if usage spikes.

Naomi
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template_sep2025.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Celia Park <celia.park@medicore.io>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:33:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request to move to Net45 + credit cap for pilot

Naomi / Marcus — quick finance read:

- We can approve a conditional credit cap of EUR 120,000 for the pilot window, subject to the standard credit check (bank reference + trade refs) and receipt of the UK tax certificate. If MedicoRe can provide the two references within 5 business days, we’ll put the cap in effect retro to the PO date.
- Payment cadence: accept Net45 for first three invoices only. After that, terms revert to Net30 unless the parties agree an extension in writing.
- Early-pay incentive: if MedicoRe pays within Net15, we can offer a 0.5% invoice-level discount (applies per invoice, not cumulative). Please note: we can’t apply discounts retroactively.

Also recommend adding an explicit consumption-surge clause: if consumption increases 30%+ month-over-month and projected run-rate exceeds 150% of the cap, we require either (a) movement to Net30 for two billing cycles or (b) an interim deposit equal to 25% of expected delta. This is to protect runway on dedicated capacity.

I’ll draft a short Finance sign-off paragraph for the amendment and send to Naomi for inclusion.

—Laura
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Celia Park <celia.park@medicore.io>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request to move to Net45 + credit cap for pilot

Hi Celia — operational notes from Customer Ops:

- We can align invoices to your billing cycle and tag them against PO 4571. If you choose the conditional cap, we’ll enable automated usage alerts at 70% and 90% of the cap and notify both sides.
- If MedicoRe requests to route invoices to the UK entity, we need: full legal billing name, UK VAT number exactly as registered, and the tax certificate (PDF). Once we receive those we’ll update the billing contact and VAT fields in our billing system; that changes how VAT is displayed but does not change underlying tax liabilities (you should confirm with your tax advisor).
- Regarding prorating: if usage spikes mid-cycle we’ll invoice actuals for that partial period; the consumption-surge clause from Finance applies.

I’ll coordinate the automated alert thresholds and also stand by for the signed amendment so we can create the billing profile.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Customer Operations, Redwood

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Celia Park <celia.park@medicore.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, MedicoRe Billing <billing@medicore.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 15:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request to move to Net45 + credit cap for pilot — amendment and next steps

Celia — thanks for your patience. Attached is a one-page amendment (redwood amendment v1) that captures: temporary Net45 for first three invoices, conditional EUR 120,000 credit cap, review trigger at 75% utilization, Finance surge protections, and the early-pay 0.5% discount for Net15. We’ve added a VAT routing table for your UK entity — please confirm the UK VAT number and attach the Tax Certificate so we can finalize.

Next steps:
1) MedicoRe: confirm UK legal billing name + VAT reg. number and return the signed amendment + tax certificate.
2) Redwood: once we receive the docs we’ll enable the EUR 120k cap and set alerts at 70%/90%, and redact the billing contact to your UK entity.
3) Payment behavior: Net45 will apply to invoices 1–3; thereafter Net30 unless extended by written mutual agreement.

Attached: Redwood amendment v1 (PDF), invoice template, and DocuSign link. If you’re free tomorrow we can do a 20-minute call to walk the amendment.

Best,
Naomi
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_Amendment_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
